items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: His real name was Eddie something, but they called him Iceberg Slim. The world's greatest black pimp.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, see, that's why they used to call him Tough Titty. His real name was Eddie something, but they called him Iceberg Slim. The world's greatest black pimp. Now, let me tell you a story about pimps.
